conclusion: Do not classify an organic top interface as floating merely because it has no same-layer trunk contact. A contact can be carried by a continuous chain of lower interface layers. The restored remove_detached_interfaces pass checks current and previous tree roads plus previously supported interfaces, retains bed foundations and bottom model contacts, and removes only wholly detached planar TopContact or TopInterface entities. Per-layer AABB indexing keeps the same geometric decisions without scanning every unrelated road.
